set.body:
Current release queue, 7 October 2026: release-later; milestone-research.
Plan: docs/refactor/RELEASE-QUEUE.md. Mote remains authoritative; one primary agent and at most one helper.

Reconciliation: Acceptance retained; this audit did not run its proposed tests.

Remaining / next action: Build one-command aggregate-only benchmark leaderboards after the declared protocol/readout, with frozen participant-average weighting, complete eligible-unit denominators and reproducible hashes. Keep sealed counters unchanged.

Release tags schedule work; they do not establish completion or empirical qualification. Use current AGENTS.md for ownership, scoped gates and exact-SHA review; old fleet roles, timers and fixed gate task counts are historical. Keep the original scientific preregistration, denominators, admission and sealed-test rules below.

Retained acceptance and design context:

Scheduling lane: research. Current plan: docs/refactor/PLAN.md. Live dependency edges supersede historical sequencing below.

Current disposition, 2026-09-19; governing docs/refactor/PLAN.md.
Research comparison retained; frozen exposure/eligibility rules apply. Not an engineering prerequisite or proof of behavioral recovery.

Original scope retained below for evidence; fleet procedure/assignments are historical and do not govern single-developer work.

Plan: docs/plans/2026-09-18-best-recall-to-video-mapper.md §3 Phase 1b Scoring and statistics, Output.

Leaderboards per corpus and track, from upstream releases plus hashed manifests, development data only for Friends and Memento until the final opening.

Scope:
The build command, its outputs and the statistics conventions.

Acceptance criteria:
1. One command regenerates every leaderboard file from upstream releases plus hashed manifests; a test rebuilds one leaderboard from scratch and compares hashes.
2. Per task, the primary estimand (participant average) and weighting are frozen before comparisons; pooled, word- and time-weighted scores are labelled secondary; fixed-denominator accounting from Phase 1a; abstention coverage is measured against all gold-eligible units.
3. Each leaderboard states split sizes and minimum detectable effects.
4. Committed leaderboard files contain only aggregates; nothing restricted is redistributed.
5. A dated study-log ledger entry (docs/plans/2026-09-02-recall-to-video-study-log.md) naming this read, its estimand and its participants is committed before the first gold read; the readout verifies the commit order.
6. The sealed-split read counts are unchanged.

Gate: every script in tools/recall-study/tests exits 0 (`for t in tools/recall-study/tests/test_*.py;
do python3 "$t" || exit 1; done`), new tests included; a named mutation witness per new guard; no
recall prose or participant text committed (hashes and aggregates only); fresh-context cold review;
the commit body states the evidence and what it does not establish.

Size: L.
